title: fix: load weekly eval key from SOPS
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Stores the eval API key in an evals-only encrypted SOPS file.
- Uses the existing SOPS age key to pass it to the weekly runner; no new GitHub Actions secret or Enter-worker secret.
- Verified local decryption, workflow syntax, a no-spend dry run, and 15 focused tests.

gist.headline: A quieter key handoff
gist.blurb: The weekly model eval runner gets its API key from an evals-only encrypted file. One less secret to thread through the workflow.
gist.summary: The weekly eval workflow decrypts an evals-only SOPS file with the existing age key to supply its API key, without adding a GitHub Actions or Enter-worker secret.
gist.impact: The weekly runner gets a dedicated encrypted source for its eval key while keeping the existing secret setup unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the weekly eval runner as a small retro terminal beside an encrypted, lime-green seed packet labeled SOPS. Polli, wearing a tiny key-shaped hair clip, hands the packet to the terminal; a code-plant and warm garden setting keep the internal tooling scene friendly.
